---
title: Raw Anchovies
id: MAR-0002
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g anchovies
- to taste juice of 2 lemons
- 2 garlic cloves
- 30 g parsley
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Clean the anchovies, removing the backbone and the head.
2. Wash them, dry them gently, and place them in a bowl, into which you will also pour the lemon juice.
3. Cover and refrigerate for about an hour.
4. Wash the parsley leaves, removing the stems, dry them, and chop them with the peeled garlic.
5. Drain the anchovies and arrange them in layers in another bowl, salting and peppering each layer.
6. Cover them with the chopped parsley, sprinkle with the oil, and serve.
